## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run a11y`, if it changes a page
- [ ] Manually with the mock engine (`npm run mock`)
- [ ] With the real model (`npm run check` / real audio), if it affects captions or latency

## Checklist

- [ ] Docs updated (reference tables, how-tos) — see .github/CONTRIBUTING.md › Documentation standards
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**
- [ ] No secrets, passwords or personal data in code, logs or examples
- [ ] Security-relevant change? Tests added and docs/security-guide.md updated
